authorship: Original Machine Move Forward compositions, written as timed notes and synthesized instruments for this iteration. No samples, copied recordings or quoted melodies.

pieces.title: Dustlight
pieces.character: A small felt-key phrase answers a low plucked string; unresolved D minor/add9 to a warm F ending.

pieces.title: Window Heat
pieces.character: Lower register open fifths, a descending three-note answer, and long gaps inside the phrase.

pieces.title: The Long Way Home
pieces.character: A restrained major-sixth color with a separated low response; the final chord is allowed to decay into silence.
